messages.subject: facet_grid & geom_hline
parts:
I'm sure this will betray yet another embarrassing misunderstanding of
ggplot2 mechanics, but I'm having troubles adding a different hline to
each panel in a plot:

p <- qplot(mpg, wt, data=mtcars, facets = vs ~ am)

hline.data = data.frame(z=1:4 , vs=c(0,0,1,1), am=c(0,1,0,1))

p+geom_hline(data=hline.data,yintercept=z)
#Error in get("new", env = GeomHline, inherits = TRUE)(GeomHline, ...) :
# object "z" not found

p+geom_hline(data=hline.data,aes(yintercept=z))
#yields lines at zero (as previously reported in this list:
# http://tinyurl.com/anoljh)

--
